name: dev.ucp.shopping.split_payments
title: Split Payments Extension
description: Enables buyers to use multiple payment instruments for a single checkout and reports their final contributions on the resulting order.

payment_instrument.title: Payment Instrument (Split Payments)
payment_instrument.description: Payment instrument extended with an optional per-instrument amount for split payments.

amount.description: Contribution amount for this instrument in the containing entity's currency minor units (ISO 4217). On a Checkout request: the platform's requested contribution (omit for open-amount). On a Checkout response: the actual amount authorized or charged (omit when not finally processed). On Order: the preserved final contribution.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Split Payments
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with split payment instrument amounts.

instruments.description: Payment instruments in allocation priority order.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Split Payments
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with optional final contribution amounts for successfully processed payment instruments.

instruments.description: Successfully processed instruments with final contribution amounts when needed to describe a split.
